items.message: Regex `LEDGER_ROW` is applied with `.match()`, which anchors only at the start of the line. A crafted line in `design/objectives.md` beginning with the expected pattern but embedding backtick-wrapped gate ids in unexpected positions could cause `CITED.findall` to extract attacker-controlled gate id strings into the `carried`/`blocked` tuples.
